question: What destructive power arises when the practitioner becomes angry?
premises: The practitioner is described as angry.
The action is the destruction of all.
The scope includes the triple world with moving and unmoving beings.
inference: When angry, the practitioner may destroy the entire triple world, both moving and unmoving.
plain_english: But when angry, he can destroy the entire triple world, with all that moves and does not move.
